question: To what kind of person, endowed with all states and of resolved mind, must something be given?
premises: Something is marked as to be given.
The intended recipient is endowed with all states.
The intended recipient is one of resolved mind.
inference: What is to be given belongs to one who is endowed with all states and of resolved mind.
uncertainties: The object to be given is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: It is to be given to one endowed with all states, to one of resolved mind.
